just the name of biryani and hyderabadis get hunger pangs and so did we when we heard about biryanis and more at gachibowli for food tasting session biryanis and more is popular name in the food industry with its branches in usa as well they are trying to spread the love for biryani across the globe with their lipsmacking varieties of biryani and after few outlets in hyderabad the newest was opened in gachibowli opposite to nissan showroom or opposite to biodiversity complex the is very easy to locate though small outlet but yet incredible simple interiors with the efficiently used for the seating the staf was really ramah and attentive and special mention to staf member sudhir who took good care of us right from the moment we entered to the time we left we being completely unaware of the menu thought that this would be just about biryanis but to our surprise this serves variety of other dishes which are really appetizing we started off with the shakes we were served the mango lassi ginger cola ginger lemon sparkling blue and virgin mojito and all of them were soo refreshing specially the sparkling blue and the ginger cola next we had the soups we were served the lemon coriander soup and the chicken manchow soup they were good and next came the starters and we had the apollo fish chilli prawns tender chicken bangla kodi corn and crispy veg the best and the must have dish among them was the tender chicken the chicken pieces were really fleshy and juicy which were well marinated and fried with breadcrumbs it was both tender and crispy at the same time really enjoyed this dish and the bangla kodi dish which was very new to us it was something very unique and spicy it is made with baked potatoes with chicken filling and then it is deeply fried you definitely should try this if you haven crispy veg made with the flour batter mixed with different veggies like onion carrots etc tasted yumm and corn was amazing soo delectable and and completely different kind of experience for person who have always had chicken the sea food was little here and there prawns were little salty and the fish wasn cooked really well soo there room for improvement when it comes to the sea food but they have covered it all up with their biryanis complete delight to your eyes and to your buds as well we had the ulavacharu chicken biryani chicken avakai biryani and chicken afghani biryani totally totally padan the money and just the best ulavacharu biryani made of the spices from horse gram has that khatta meetha in it making it soo soo damn awesome it is said that ulavacharu gives heat to your body soo don forget to have some curd yoghurt or the raita to make it even and then there was this chicken avakai biryani yet another mindblowing avakai means mango and this biryani is made from the spices of mango it had the of the mango pickle never had we imagined that we ever be eating chicken biryani with the of mango pickle then came the afghani biryani it just the opposite of ulavacharu and avakai when it comes to the spicy level really flavourful and palatable biryani served with an omelette on top believe us if you re biryani lover then this should be definitely be in your list gonna go back again for the biryani the other main course included naan basket with chicken tikka masala and chicken chettinadu as you must be knowing chicken chettinadu popular dish from tamil nadu is very spicy dish and yet very and here at biryanis and more they have kept up with that level of spicy ness and also the soo the main course here is the real stunner next we had the desserts ever wished to be ganesh gaitonde you definitely do not want that life but yes you can enjoy the same makan tutup which he just loves the kharvas also called as junnu is an indian milk pudding and it is made from the colostrum of the cow we don know how the actual of the junnu is as we never had it before but yes here at biryanis and more the was superb you ought to have this makan tutup to get that gaitonde feels next in line were the gulab jamun and qubani ka meetha the presentation of the desserts isn really appealing soo the hotel management should definitely look after that and make some changes but the was good soo if you love to enjoy variety in biryani then biryanis and more should be your next stop you re going to love it
